description.zh: 消费金额调整方向 increase:增加,用户消费增加金额 decrease:减少,用户充值减少金额 [必填]
description.en: The type of the consumption amount adjustment. Valid values: increase: The consumption amount increases because new consumption occurs. decrease: The consumption amount decreases because funds are added to the account. This parameter is required.

description.zh: 调整金额,单位为元,金额必须大于0。
description.en: The amount to be adjusted. Unit: CNY

description.zh: 外部业务主键ID，用于做幂等性校验使用
description.en: The ID of the primary key for external business. The ID is used for idempotence verification.

description.zh: 请求来源，填写系统名称即可
description.en: The source of the request. Specify the system name for the parameter.
